snippet.title: New demo for Yesterdreamt
snippet.description:
Check out the new demo: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1637180/Yesterdreamt/

Heavy movement, limited ammo and precious sanity. Yesterdreamt is a twin-stick horrorvania where the odds are stacked against you, Gunslinger. Unlock arcanicks to tip the scales and keep close to your dog, and you might just win this fight. And if you were to fall, well… Blessed be the Dreamweavers.
